integrity: The result includes a complete analytic reduction and exact formula, an independently replayable exact-rational quadratic-surd witness, and numerical finite-grid diagnostics clearly distinguished from proof. Formal external or independent audit has not been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two scored time points, scalar fully observed system, identity second-moment budget, positive-definite weight with nonzero cross coefficient, independent centered finite-variance disturbance. Linearized covariance oracle, not the full inverse-information design objective. The qualitative singular-Riccati mechanism is known from the motivating literature. No claim about multidimensional systems, arbitrary horizons, finite precision, or independent validation.
title: An exact excitation-budget transition for the two-step scalar input-design oracle
